name: Misaki Youko
source:
She an older woman who runs the only barbershop in in the village, She's known as "Barber Misaki".

She remains youthful and her flamboyant appearance and personality makes her stand out from the crowd in the village. Since, junior high school, she had been a beautiful girl with big breasts, making her the target for constant rumors regarding her having romantic relationships with many men, she would be regularly shunned by the women of the village.

After graduating from high school, she moved to Tokyo to become an actress, but her dream did not come true and about 10 years later she returned to the village and started a barbershop.

Perhaps because she had been through the rough and tumble of the city, she has lost all of her moxie, and now has a calm and easygoing personality. No one in the village knows what kind of rough times he went through.


However, perhaps because of her youth, he is still a bit out of place in the village. The main character is a regular customer who comes to the barbershop without any regard for such things. On his off days the main character has a habit of going to the barbershop to read manga. She buys new issues of manga several times a month for him.

She has been watching over the main character since he was a child, but recently she has noticed that he sees her as a woman, and she is happy but at the same time confused.
